easy.def: To make someone feel shy or silly.
examples: It would embarrass me to sing alone.
Please do not embarrass me in front of my friends.

more.def: To make someone feel awkward or ashamed in front of others.
examples: Tripping on stage embarrassed him, but he kept going.
He did not mean to embarrass his sister by telling the story.
Forgetting her lines embarrassed the young actor.

easy.def: A sudden, scary event when you need help fast.
examples: This door is only for an emergency.

more.def: A sudden and serious event that needs quick action.
examples: Call for help in an emergency.
The hospital treats emergencies all night.
